summary: Reuse verified exact-source release artifacts on retry and allow ten minutes for macOS installer checks instead of five

replay.detail: No runtime replay or projection changes.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Candidate reuse requires a successful verified build and the matching source SHA; release artifacts and installer contracts are unchanged. The macOS installer CI budget is ten minutes; Linux remains at five minutes.

downtime.detail: No runtime activation or service interruption.

manual.detail: Existing automatic release selection and publication approval remain available.

recovery.detail: A release operator can retry draft creation using the same verified run and source SHA without rebuilding the binaries.
